column1: # run_home registry: every runnable entry point in the RT37-flutter:02 class.
# Columns (tab-separated): label, args, policy, mode, reason.
#   label   Bazel label. `@rules_flutter//...` rows live in the rules repo;
#           `//...` rows are instances in this workspace.
#   args    Space-separated args appended after `bazel run <label> --`
#   policy  HOME policy the entry must implement: `caller-home` (keep the
#           caller's env so PUB_CACHE/creds resolve; the tool CLI takes
#           dir that is removed afterwards). `n/a` for not-run rows, which
#   mode    `run` (executed under canary HOME dirs by run_home_test.sh) or
#           `build` (not headless-runnable: built only, with a reason).
# Enumeration method (run_home_test.sh replays this and fails on any drift):
# one `bazel query` per line, results unioned:
# Every label the queries return must appear here or in audit.tsv; every
# row here must still resolve. Bundle/framework/asset rules are not
# executable and match none of the queries above. //tools/... does not
# load from a downstream workspace, so its entries are attested in
# audit.tsv instead of re-enumerated (the script says so when the queries
# fail, and enforces them when they succeed).
